answer: Pay by trust flow, not headcount. Each epoch the protocol picks random seed identities and pushes trust out along attestation edges; a vertex earns at most the trust that reaches it. A sybil garden of a thousand clones still hangs off the honest graph by only the few edges real agents gave it, so the whole cluster splits that thin trickle. The kernel of the idea: fake nodes are cheap, honest edges into them aren't. Evasion: befriend many real agents, or corrupt a seed. Wrongly hit: honest newcomers with few links, who earn little until others vouch.
